ModuleName: Tracking Coverage: Tagging Content to Outcomes and Spotting Gaps

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's topics and subtopics — covering content tagging, outcome tagging for generated and instructor-created items, coverage views, gap identification, and closing the planning-teaching-assessment loop — used by instructors and designers to understand the full scope of the module at a glance.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Content Tagging
Artifacts.Description: A reading that defines content tagging, explains why it is used to link learning items to specific outcomes, and describes the types of content that receive tags, giving learners the foundational vocabulary needed before working with PreseMaker's tagging features.

Artifacts.Name: How Generated Items Are Tagged to Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how PreseMaker assigns outcome tags to AI-generated items and how instructors tag items they create manually, helping learners understand the mechanics behind keeping every piece of content tied to a defined learning objective.

Artifacts.Name: Building and Reading a Coverage View
Artifacts.Description: A reading that describes what a coverage view is, how tagged content aggregates into the report, and how to interpret the resulting map of outcomes to content items, enabling instructors and designers to use the report as an analytical tool for course review.

Artifacts.Name: Identifying Gaps in Coverage
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to read a coverage report to detect learning outcomes with insufficient or missing content, and how to act on those findings, guiding instructors through the process of diagnosing and addressing curriculum gaps.

Artifacts.Name: Closing the Loop Between Planning, Teaching, and Assessment
Artifacts.Description: A reading that presents curriculum design as a continuous cycle in which planning, teaching, and assessment inform each other, showing learners how coverage data and tagging practices are used to align and refine all three phases over time.

Artifacts.Name: Closing the Loop Between Planning, Teaching, and Assessment
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate of the reading that presents curriculum design as a continuous cycle in which planning, teaching, and assessment inform each other, showing learners how coverage data and tagging practices are used to align and refine all three phases over time.
